#!/bin/bash
# DIAWW.DEV - Pterodactyl Bun Installation Script

apt update -y
apt install -y git curl ca-certificates unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[1;33m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m USER_UPLOAD enabled. Skipping git clone."
    exit 0
fi

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[1;33m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m No GIT_ADDRESS specified. Creating default index.ts..."
    if [ ! -f index.ts ] && [ ! -f index.js ]; then
        cat << 'EOF' > index.ts
console.log("[DIAWW.DEV] Bun container is up and running!");
setInterval(() => {
    console.log("[DIAWW.DEV] Server heartbeat tick: " + new Date().toISOString());
}, 30000);
EOF
    fi
    exit 0
fi

GIT_TARGET="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
if [ ! -z "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ ! -z "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    GIT_TARGET="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

echo -e "\033[1;36m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m Cloning repository from ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
    git clone ${GIT_TARGET} .
else
    git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_TARGET} .
fi

PKG_TARGET="${PACKAGE_FILE}"
if [ -z "${PKG_TARGET}" ]; then PKG_TARGET="package.json"; fi
if [ -f "${PKG_TARGET}" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[1;36m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m Installing dependencies from ${PKG_TARGET}..."
    bun install
fi

echo -e "\033[1;32m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m Installation complete!"

variables.name: Main Application File
variables.description: The entrypoint file to run with Bun (e.g. index.ts, index.js, or server.ts).

variables.name: Package JSON File (Optional)
variables.description: The package configuration file to install dependencies from (defaults to package.json). Optional: if file does not exist, it will be skipped safely.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically perform a 'git pull' on every container start if a .git repository exists.

variables.name: Additional Bun Arguments
variables.description: Additional CLI arguments or flags passed to the Bun process (e.g. --watch, --hot).

variables.name: Additional Bun Packages
variables.description: Space-separated list of extra packages to install automatically on startup using bun add without modifying package.json.

variables.name: Uninstalled Bun Packages
variables.description: Space-separated list of packages to uninstall on startup using bun remove.

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description: Git repository URL to clone during initial server setup (e.g., https://github.com/user/repo.git).

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Specific Git branch to clone during setup (leave blank for default branch).

variables.name: User Upload Only
variables.description: Set to 1 or true if you upload files manually via SFTP instead of cloning a Git repository.
